Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium, shippable-looking 16:9 TV tennis GAMEPLAY HUD mockup for Motion Club, a joyful friends-first iPhone-controlled party sports game with a refined coastal country-club/resort identity. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an actual Unity gameplay capture. Preserve its court, net, ball, yellow landing marker, scenery, camera position and BOTH EXISTING CHARACTERS exactly: do not regenerate scenery or redesign/improve character meshes/hair. Image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the existing Motion Club cream/navy/lime, joyful resort brand; do not copy its menu, logo layout or scene into gameplay. Overlay only beautiful, precisely typeset ORIGINAL game HUD. Keep actual playable centre and lower-centre character entirely unobstructed. Typography must be exceptionally sharp, professionally kerned, optical alignment, large couch-readable tabular numerals, credible shipping-console-game polish, carefully proportioned components. Main score data exactly: ADNAN 3 games 30 points, MILO 2 games 15 points; a small lime tennis-ball server dot alongside ADNAN; small labels GAMES and PTS so numbers are unambiguous; SET 1. Add a compact transient shot-feedback widget at lower left reading PERFECT and 98 km/h, restrained emphasis and fine visual hierarchy, distinct from scorebug. Minimal circular pause symbol at upper right. No virtual joysticks, no on-screen dive button (phone owns that), no ultimate, abilities, rankings, currencies, XP, fake HUD stats, banners, layout captions, editor annotations, watermarks or large brand logo. This is mid-rally so there is NO SERVE METER; do not create, restyle or replace the existing game's serve meter. Entire image is the gameplay screen, not a presentation board or collage. Exact UI copy only as specified.
DIRECTION: CLUB BROADCAST. Compact stacked two-player scorebug anchored top LEFT within 5% safe margins, roughly 23% screen width and 14% screen height. Small deep navy SET 1 header, warm ivory scoreboard faces, subtly inset navy point tiles, name rows separated by fine navy rule, very thin antique brass detail, quiet lime serving dot, refined small corner radius 12px. Convincing restrained physical depth: 1px ivory top edge, soft navy ambient shadow 6px below, subtle ceramic/satin panel material, NOT glossy inflated toy buttons. Strong asymmetrical information hierarchy, points largest, games secondary. Crisp navy typography. Feedback is an ivory lozenge with small lime accent and solid navy PERFECT, speed secondary. Warm, sophisticated, sporty and relaxed. This should be the most balanced readable option, visually matching the menu brand.

states:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: Motion Club premium in-game tennis HUD COMPONENT STATE REVIEW BOARD. Image 1 is the approved-for-this-review STYLE REFERENCE, especially its TOP-LEFT cream/navy scoreboard and cream/lime shot feedback. Reproduce those exact materials, navy typographic shapes, tabular scores, slender brass keylines, softly inset navy point tiles, thin ivory top edge, subtle shadows and moderate roundings; not a whole new style. Create a beautifully spacious 16:9 board on warm ivory with six clearly separated areas in a 3-column by 2-row grid, no gameplay or characters needed. Large clear header 'MOTION CLUB / MATCH UI'. Each area contains REAL finished component examples at generous readable size, not placeholder rectangles. Professional production UI art, restrained premium detail, large lovely readable numerals, no fake perspective, no gloss blobs, no comic type. Original resort tennis identity. Exact specified text and numbers, no extra text:
Top-left, label 'DEUCE': compact scoreboard SET 1, column headers GAMES and PTS; ADNAN games 3 points 40; MILO games 2 points 40; small lime serving-ball dot beside MILO. A small attached navy/cream label says DEUCE.
Top-middle, label 'BREAK POINT': same scoreboard ADNAN games 3 points 40, MILO games 2 points 30, server dot beside MILO; an attached small lime accented label BREAK POINT. This is Adnan returning at break point.
Top-right, label 'ADVANTAGE': same scoreboard ADNAN games 3 points AD, MILO games 2 points 40, server dot beside MILO; small label ADVANTAGE ADNAN.
Bottom-left, label 'SHOT FEEDBACK': three compact beautifully aligned feedback pills from reference. PERFECT / 98 km/h with lime small speed-ball icon. GOOD / 82 km/h with navy restrained accent. LATE / 65 km/h with muted orange accent. Text stays navy on cream. Never turn these into huge achievement badges.
Bottom-middle, label 'POINT CALLS': three elegant small wide call banners stacked: 'POINT ADNAN' with below '+1 POINT' omitted entirely; 'ACE' with secondary 'ADNAN'; 'OUT' with secondary 'POINT MILO'. Navy/ivory, tasteful lime confirmation detail. These are quick transient tennis umpire calls, not victory or reward screens. NO XP, stars, coins, ultimates, rank or confetti wallpaper.
Bottom-right, label 'SERVE CALLS': three restrained pills 'LET' / 'SERVE AGAIN', 'FAULT' / 'SECOND SERVE', 'DOUBLE FAULT' / 'POINT MILO'. Firm hierarchy, tiny warm-orange fault cue, no serve meter, no skill minigame, no controller buttons.
Board is crisp contemporary sports-game art direction, subtle real depth and polished typography, even generous gutters. Show all six areas fully with ample safe margins.
